title: Supergirl #16 17 Lot DC Comics 2018 Rebirth Strange Visitor Plain Sight Orlando
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:

You get:
- #16 - "The Wrath of Strange Visitor!", Robson Rocha cover
- #17 - "Plain Sight", Robson Rocha cover

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
